phase_prompt.summary: The Moon in its default state: pristine silver sphere with mechanical iris and glitching LED mesh.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic 3D render of the Moon as a perfect silver sphere, encased in matte black interlocking panels etched with ancient Ethiopian motifs, featuring a massive mechanical iris that rotates to cast a crescent shadow, a crystalline core emitting cold white light, and a hexagonal LED mesh glitching like a failing lightbulb, all set against a geodesic dome sky with LED nodes, illuminated by a focused blue moonlight beam, cinematic lighting, high contrast, 8k resolution
